scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const d of ['data','config','schemas']) fs.cpSync('../../'+d,'dist/'+d,{recursive:true});"
scripts.test: node tests/generate-test-cases.js && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.readdirSync('tests').filter(f=>f.startsWith('test-cases-')).forEach(f=>fs.cpSync('tests/'+f, 'dist/apps/api/tests/'+f))" && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/apps/api/tests/api.test.js dist/apps/api/tests/api-e2e.test.js dist/apps/api/tests/api-sqlite.test.js dist/apps/api/tests/api-data-driven.test.js
